cases.sentence: обещание Бога о входе в его ___ остается в силе.
cases.translation: God's promise about entering into His rest remains in effect.
cases.explain: The transitive verb входить requires accusative case for the destination.

cases.sentence: Но еще не поздно, и обещание Бога о входе в его покой остается в ___ силе.
cases.translation: But it is not yet too late, and God's promise about entering into His rest remains in effect.
cases.explain: The prepositional phrase 'в силе' uses the preposition в which requires prepositional case.

cases.sentence: обещание Бога о входе в его покой, если бы вы верили в ___.
cases.translation: God's promise about entering into His rest, if you would believe in the covenant.
cases.explain: The transitive verb верить (believe in) with the preposition в requires accusative case.

cases.sentence: Но мы, поверившие, входим в его ___, так как Бог сказал.
cases.translation: But we who believe enter into His rest, as God said.
cases.explain: The transitive verb входить (enter) governs the accusative case for the destination.

cases.sentence: В другом месте он сказал о седьмом ___.
cases.translation: In another place he said about the seventh day.
cases.explain: The preposition о (about) requires the prepositional case.

cases.sentence: На седьмой день Бог отдыхал от своего ___.
cases.translation: On the seventh day God rested from His work.
cases.explain: The preposition от (from) governs the genitive case.

cases.sentence: Кто входит в покой ___, тот отдыхает от своих трудов.
cases.translation: Whoever enters God's rest rests from his labors.
cases.explain: The genitive possessive construction 'покой Бога' means 'God's rest' and requires genitive case.

cases.sentence: Ведь Слово Божие живет и действует, оно острее, чем любой обоюдоострый ___.
cases.translation: For the word of God is living and active, and sharper than any two-edged sword.
cases.explain: The comparative construction requires accusative case for the object being compared.

reading.ru: Но еще не поздно, и обещание Бога о входе в его покой остается в силе.
reading.question: What remains in effect according to this verse?
options: God's promise about entering into His rest
reading.correct: God's promise about entering into His rest
reading.explain: The verse states that 'the promise of God about entering into His rest remains in effect.'

reading.ru: нам так же, как и этим восставшим, была возвещена радостная весть, но им эта весть никакой пользы не принесла.
reading.question: Why did the glad tidings not profit those who heard them?
options: Because they did not receive it with faith
reading.correct: Because they did not receive it with faith
reading.explain: The passage explains that the word 'didn't profit them, because it wasn't mixed with faith by those who heard.'

reading.ru: Поэтому субботний покой остается для народа Божьего.
reading.question: For whom does Sabbath rest remain?
reading.explain: The text says 'a Sabbath rest remains for the people of God.'

reading.ru: Кто входит в покой Божий, тот отдыхает от своих трудов точно так же, как и Бог от своих.
reading.question: What happens when someone enters into God's rest?
options: They rest from their labors just as God rests from His
reading.correct: They rest from their labors just as God rests from His
reading.explain: The verse explains the nature of God's rest: those who enter it rest from their works as God did.

reading.ru: Ведь Слово Божие живет и действует, оно острее, чем любой обоюдоострый меч.
reading.question: What is said about the Word of God in this verse?
options: It is living and active, sharper than any two-edged sword
It is written on stone tablets
It is found in the temple
reading.correct: It is living and active, sharper than any two-edged sword
reading.explain: The passage describes the Word of God as 'living and active, and sharper than any two-edged sword.'

reading.ru: Ничто во всем творении не скрыто от Него.
reading.question: What is revealed about God's knowledge?
options: Nothing in all creation is hidden from Him
He knows only what the prophets tell Him
reading.correct: Nothing in all creation is hidden from Him
reading.explain: The text states 'There is no creature that is hidden from his sight.'
